crossRefs.note: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

people.name: Ikkesh
people.line: Father of Ira, one of David's mighty warriors.

people.name: Ira
people.line: One of David's Thirty warriors, from Tekoa.

people.name: Tekoa
people.line: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos

translations.web: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
